body:
@vvo my use case is:
When working with `react-router`, it's a change from `/detail/11` to `/detail/12` (`/detail/:newId:`),
I also have a custom `createConnector` to calculate some derivative values based on `searchResults` and props (in this case, it's `newId`).
But `getProvidedProps` still receives the old value `11` after the route is changed, then it's this bug.
